name: refactor-cowork-to-team-ai-manages-ai-team-with-waveai-as-manager-member-templates-with-worker-instances-full-rename-cowork-team
title: Refactor cowork to team - AI manages AI team with WaveAI as manager, Member templates with Worker instances, full rename cowork→team
creator: re2zero

children.name: Phase1B: pkg/team/team_db.go — DB CRUD layer
children.description: Implement the database CRUD layer for the team feature at pkg/team/team_db.go. This provides Create/Get/Update/Delete/List operations for Members, Workers, Tasks, and Activity. Also includes GetStatus aggregate query and WPS event publishing.

children.name: Phase1B: pkg/team/team_fork.go — Worker fork/recycle logic
children.description: Implement Worker fork and recycle logic. ForkWorker checks MaxConcurrency, generates runtime names (MemberName-N), creates DB entries. RecycleWorker updates status and records Activity. GetNextWorkerNumber provides atomic counter.

children.name: Phase1B: pkg/team/team_inject.go — CLI config injection
children.description: Implement CLI configuration injection for Workers. Includes: InjectWorkerConfig (dispatch to tool-specific injection), loadPersona (read personaPath or inline), linkSkills/unlinkSkills (symlink management), injectMCP (MCP config files per CLI tool).

children.name: Phase1B: pkg/team/team_heartbeat.go — Worker health check
children.description: Implement Worker heartbeat monitoring. CheckWorkerHealth queries active workers, checks PID via os.FindProcess, marks offline if dead. StartHeartbeatLoop runs periodic checks via goroutine with ticker.

children.name: Phase1B: pkg/team/team_config.go — Config file system
children.description: Implement config file loading system. LoadGlobalTemplates reads ~/.waveterm/team-templates/*.yaml. LoadProjectConfig reads .wave/team.yaml. ParseMemberYAML unmarshals YAML to TeamMember. GetEffectiveConfig merges project + global. Include 4 built-in default templates.

children.name: Phase1C: RPC type definitions in wshrpctypes.go
children.description: Remove all Cowork* types from pkg/wshrpc/wshrpctypes.go and add Team* types. This includes all Team command/request/response types, TeamMember/TeamWorker/TeamTask TeamXxxCommand structs, and TeamXxxCommandReturn structs. Also update WshRPCServer interface to remove Cowork methods and add Team methods.

children.name: Phase1C: RPC server handlers in wshserver.go
children.description: Remove Cowork handler registrations from pkg/wshrpc/wshserver/wshserver.go and add Team handler implementations. Each handler delegates to the corresponding pkg/team/ function. Register all Team handlers in init().

children.name: Phase1C: RPC client stubs in wshclient.go
children.description: Remove Cowork client methods from pkg/wshrpc/wshclient/wshclient.go and add Team client methods following the existing pattern. Each method sends the RPC command and returns the response.

children.name: Phase1D: WPS events + tsgen updates
children.description: Update pkg/wps/wpstypes.go: rename Event_CoworkTaskUpdate→Event_TeamTaskUpdate, Event_CoworkWorkerUpdate→Event_TeamWorkerUpdate, add Event_TeamMemberUpdate. Update pkg/tsgen/tsgenevent.go with same renames. Update pkg/waveobj/objrtinfo.go: WaveAICoworkMode→WaveAITeamMode.

children.name: Phase1D: AI tools (tools_team.go) + system prompt
children.description: Create pkg/aiusechat/tools_team.go with 15 team_* AI tools (team_fork_worker, team_list_workers, team_list_members, team_create_member, team_update_member, team_delete_member, team_create_task, team_assign_task, team_update_task, team_get_status, team_execute_task, team_recycle_worker, team_send_prompt, team_get_task_output, team_list_activity). Follow callback pattern from tools_cowork.go. Also update usechat-prompts.go (CoworkMode→TeamMode prompt), usechat.go, and uctypes/uctypes.go.

children.name: Phase1E: Unit tests for pkg/team/
children.description: Create pkg/team/team_test.go with comprehensive unit tests. Cover: Member CRUD, Worker CRUD, Task CRUD, Activity logging, state machine validation, fork/recycle logic, config parsing. Target coverage >= 85%. Use raw testing package (no testify/gomock).

notes: Phase 1A completed (migration + team_types.go). 11 children decomposed for cowork dispatch.
